description: Two many relations between tables share one derived join table

statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `article` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `heading` text,
  CONSTRAINT `article_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `article_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `article_owner_index` ON `article` (`owner`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `article_tag` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `article_id` blob NOT NULL,
  `tag_id` blob NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `article_tag_article_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`article_id`) REFERENCES `article`(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `article_tag_tag_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`tag_id`) REFERENCES `tag`(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `article_tag_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `article_tag_article_id_tag_id_unique` UNIQUE(`article_id`, `tag_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `article_tag_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `article_tag_article_id_index` ON `article_tag` (`article_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `article_tag_tag_id_index` ON `article_tag` (`tag_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `article_tag_owner_index` ON `article_tag` (`owner`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tag` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `name` text,
  CONSTRAINT `tag_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `tag_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `tag_owner_index` ON `tag` (`owner`)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `article_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `article`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `article`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `article_tag_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `article_tag`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `article_tag`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `tag_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `tag`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `tag`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE VIEW `article_view` AS
SELECT
  `t`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`heading` AS `heading`,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_group_array(json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'name', `r`.`name`)), json('[]')) FROM `tag` AS `r` JOIN `article_tag` AS `j` ON `j`.`tag_id` = `r`.`id` WHERE `j`.`article_id` = `t`.`id` ORDER BY `r`.`id`) AS `tags`
FROM `article` AS `t`

CREATE VIEW `article_tag_view` AS
SELECT
  `t`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`article_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`article_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`article_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`article_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`article_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`article_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `article_id`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`tag_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`tag_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`tag_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`tag_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`tag_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`tag_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `tag_id`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'heading', `r`.`heading`) FROM `article` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `t`.`article_id` LIMIT 1) AS `article`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'name', `r`.`name`) FROM `tag` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `t`.`tag_id` LIMIT 1) AS `tag`
FROM `article_tag` AS `t`

CREATE VIEW `tag_view` AS
SELECT
  `t`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`name` AS `name`,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_group_array(json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'heading', `r`.`heading`)), json('[]')) FROM `article` AS `r` JOIN `article_tag` AS `j` ON `j`.`article_id` = `r`.`id` WHERE `j`.`tag_id` = `t`.`id` ORDER BY `r`.`id`) AS `articles`
FROM `tag` AS `t`
